main.description: A Bardcast character's durable identity: who they are, independent of any campaign. Lives in the player's own repo, so it stays portable off Bardcast. A player can have several characters, one record each (rkey: tid). Mechanics live in game.bardcast.character.sheet (same repo, same rkey); what a character is at one table lives in game.bardcast.campaign.seat inside that campaign's space.

player.description: DID of the player who portrays this character. The durable identity key the character hangs off of.

displayName.description: The character's name as it appears in narration.

concept.description: One-line concept, e.g. 'a guilt-ridden paladin who left her order'.

drives.description: What motivates the character, across every campaign they appear in. Used by the narrative engine.

createdAt.description: Real ISO 8601 creation time. NOT the in-world date (see stateEvent.storyDate).
